content: Kwa yenio lilaghalikilo lya Mucha ndi kiyeka tugha cha ilebhe yambone ihika palongoloho, na chi ilebhe ya uchakaka. Matambiko ghanga gha Mucha ghapihitwa kwa kubhujhila bhujhila kila chaka changalekwa yatenda jhe ng'o bhala bhibhamandikii Chapanga kubhehe akakamilipo!

Anda bhando bheniya bhibhanyinamila Chapanga bhakabhii bhajhelehwilwe uhakaho gwabhe chakaka, miojho jhabhe ngaibhinitii jhe kulangiya ibhii na uhakaho, nabhajhendelela jhe kupiya kabhele lyenio litambiko.
Nambo matambiko ghala ghibhabhujhii kila chaka kwakombocha bhando uhakaho gwabhe.
Kwa nhwalo miyahe jha lipongo lya ng'ombi na mbuhe ihoto jhe kubhoha uhakaho.
Nhwalo Kilichitu pahikita pannema pano, akannobhalile Chapanga:

content.text: “Mukapahii jhe bhapiye litambiko hilu hupo henge,
amu litambiko lya kubhoha uhakaho kwangahalalicha.
Peniya nganongila, ‘Mii pamba, mwe ma Chapanga,
ngita chinyandikilwe mu Majhandiko gha Chapanga.’ ”

content: Hote akalongi, “Mihalalichwa jhe na litambiko lyukutiniwa kwa mwotu, litambiko lya kukomelekelwa kwa inyama na litambiko lya kubhoha uhakaho.” Akalongii naha ata ngita matambiko ghala ghoha ghighapihitwe kwa kukengama lilaghalikilo lya Mucha.
Peniya akalongi: “Mii pamba, mwe ma Chapanga, kuhenga ghimipala mwenga.” Yene Chapanga ajhakulibhoha litambiko lya makacho na kummeka Kilichitu jwenie ngita litambiko.
Kwa mana Yecho Kilichitu akatehi ghala ghapala Chapanga, twenga tujhelewike uhakaho gwito kwa litambiko lya yegha jhake jwenio jhapihite mala jhimo tugha kwa nhwalo gwa bhando bhoha.
Kila mpiya litambiko jwa Akayahude ihenga lihengo lya kupiya litambiko kila lichiko na ipiya matambiko ghagha mala jhamahele, matambiko gheniya ghahoto ng'o kubhoha uhakaho.
Nambo Kilichitu apihita litambiko limo tugha nhwalo gwa kubhoha uhakaho, litambiko lilibhii lyamaha machiko ghoha ghangapeta, peniya atamite lubhoko lwalelo lwa Chapanga,
na ngohe ilendelela akamakoko bhake bhabhekwe pahe jha magholo ghake.
Bhahe, kwa litambiko lyake limo, abhatei kubhehe akakamilipo machiko ghoha ghangapeta bhala bhibhajhelehwike.
Uhuke gwa Chapanga helahela itulongelela twenga malobhe gha ilebhe henge. Hote alonge,

content.text: palonge jha machiko ghighahika, ilonge Bhambo,
nameka lilaghalikilo lyango mu mumiojho jhabhe,

content: Kabhele ngalongila: “Nakombokela jhe kabhele uhakaho gwabhe na mahengo ghanganandela.”
Anda ngohe uhakaho ulekekiwe, nakubhe jhe kabhele kupiya litambiko lya kulekekeya uhakaho.
Tunheghelele Chapanga
Ngohe akalongo bhango, kwa miyahe jha Yecho tuhoto njwe kujhingii Panyahinyahi Hake changakiholo.
Jwenio atujhogholii ndela yono, ndela jhitulongocha mu ughome, kupete panjiya jhela, atehila yenio kwa kubhowa yegha jhake.
Ngohe tukwete Mpiya litambiko Nkolongwa jwabhii na ukindendeke mu Nyumba jha Chapanga.

Kwa yenio tumandikile Chapanga kongo tubhii na uchakaka na kihobholelo cha uchakaka kwa miojho jhijhelehwike jhilangiya kubhehe nkwetii jhe ulemo, tuuleke ubhoho na yegha jhito ichukwe kwa mache ghamaha.
Tukamule hake lihobhalelo lito litulonge twabhete, nhwalo Chapanga jwateile lilaghano lyake ndi jwahobholeka.
Tuwachilana twenga kwa twenga, tulekelane mwojho, tughaghe mu kupalana na kuhenga ghamaha.
Tukoto kukotoka kukongana pamonga, ngita bhange chibhihenga. Bhahe, nambo tukangamaliche mwojho na tujhendelele kuhenga yenio, ngita chimulola machiko gha Bhambo ghabhandikile.
Kwa nhwalo, anda tujhendelii kuhenga uhakaho kwa kupala kone anda tujhomolee kuumanya uchakaka, libhii jhe litambiko lilihoto kupiwa kabhele kwa nhwalo gwa kubhoha uhakaho.
Chikihighilike ndi kulendela tugha kwa ubhoghohe luhadabulo lwa Chapanga na mwotu nkale ghuupala kwakomelekeya bhala bhoha bhibhankana Chapanga.
Mundo jhojhoha jwangakamula lilaghalikilo lya Mucha, akakomitwe changa kiya anda bhabhii bhando bhabhele amu bhatato bhalolite na kulonge kilebhe chenie.

Ngohe mihola bhole? Bho, ipalwa ahadabulwa pakolongwa bhole mundo jhola jwampucha Mwana gwa Chapanga nakulola kilebhe nacho miyahe jha lilaghano lya Chapanga lilinyelewile na mundo jwanigha Uhuke gwa Chapanga jwatulangiya kiya?
Kwa nhwalo tummanye chalongila jhola: “Nenga naninepa jhe ghanganandela, nenga nanepechela bheniya,” na helahela alongela: “Bhambo nabhahadabula bhando bhake.”
Kilebhe cha kujhoghopa kugwelela mu mabhoko gha Chapanga jwabhii ghome!
Nambo nkomboka machiko ghala gha kutumbula pala puyekulilwa uchakaka gwa Chapanga. Pamonga na mangota mukang'ahike hake, mangota mkahimbilile.
Pipipi mkaligwite na kutendelwa ghanganandela na kumpe hone pa bhando, pipipi mu kulombana na bhala bhubhang'ahichwa hele.
Helahela mukang'ahike pamonga na bhala bhubhabhii mu kipungo na pumpokitwa ilebhe hino mukajheketile kwa kuhangana, nhwalo mkamanye nkwete kilebhe chambone hake na kitamikii machiko ghoha ghangapeta.
Ngohe, nkoto kuhobheya lihobhalelo lino, nhwalo nalimpela hupo ngolongwa.
Mipalwa kubhehe na luhimbililo ndi mihoto kuhenga ghala ghapala Chapanga na kupokela chela chalaghile.
Ngita chilonge Majhandiko gha Chapanga:

content.text: Nambo jhola jwahenga ghighahalalila nenga natama kwa kihobholela,

content: Nambo, twe twabhando bhukubhujha unyuma jhe nu kuwegha mu kihobholelo, nambo twenga tubhii na kihobholelo na kughombolelwa.
